_comment: Config-time EQ band map for banks-frontend cabin audio. Read at app start (live runtime change not supported - edit + restart banks-frontend). /data/banks-frontend/eq-profile.json overrides this file.
_custom_note: Instead of a named bandMap you may inline a 'bands' array of {freq,type,q} (type = peaking|lowshelf|highshelf). Max 12 bands; per-channel crossover stages share the 12-biquad budget with EQ bands.
